steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja: 

❓ How does the project know which status bar value to change? How can you make it more specific?


Solution: 

The (status bar kind attached to sprite) block from the < > comparison block in the [if then] conditional should be duplicated, then dragged to replace (statusbar) in the [change (statusbar) [value] by] block.

Oh no - these programs aren’t working! Problems in code are called bugs. Find and fix the bugs in the code in each section!


Fix the bugs in the code so that a status bar is attached to the correct sprite and changes correctly throughout the project.

steps.instructions:
When the project runs, each Bunny sprite’s status bar does not begin at fully hungry (fully yellow).


Fix the bugs in the code so that each time a Bunny sprite is set, its status bar is set to the maximum level of hunger, not a percentage value.

attributes.description: You’ve reached Level 5 of Green Belt! Before you create your final Green Belt project, there are a few neat tricks to learn that could take your game to the next level! Here are the achievements you’ll unlock in Level 5:

badges.title: Extension Explorer

badges.description: Set a project’s background to scroll horizontally, vertically, or diagonally.
